content:
1|name: trimtok
2|version: 4.2.6
3|description: "Local context compressor: per-command budgets, balanced windowing, error rails, Drain templates, shingle near-dedup, HEAD_TAIL stubs, cross-turn fold, command/tool exclusions, two-tier SQLite CCR with short #ref aliases and section retrieval (errors/diff/summary/tail), scoped search grouping, lossless TOON v2 hierarchical columnar JSON tables, cross-turn fuzzy delta engine (STILL FAILING / +added / -removed), structured traceback & semantic diff pruner, fail-open guard (guard_ms, default 200)."
4|entry_point: __init__.py
5|author: "P Choke & MIKA"
6|provides_hooks:
7|  - transform_terminal_output
8|  - transform_tool_result
9|  - post_llm_call
10|  - on_session_start
11|  - on_session_end
12|provides_tools:
13|  - trimtok_retrieve
14|config_schema:
15|  enabled:
16|    type: bool
17|    default: true
18|    description: Master switch for all hooks (fail-open; false = passthrough).
19|  guard_ms:
20|    type: float
21|    default: 200
22|    description: Fail-open deadline budget in ms (1-1000); hooks return the original text when exceeded. 200 covers the observed p99 (63ms) and worst real case (145ms); at 50 every payload over ~9K tokens timed out and saved nothing.
23|  phase2_enabled:
24|    type: bool
25|    default: true
26|    description: transform_tool_result switch (cross-turn fold).
27|  mask_enabled:
28|    type: bool
29|    default: true
30|    description: post_llm_call fold-index expiry (turn freshness mask).
31|  mask_keep_turns:
32|    type: int
33|    default: 2
34|    description: Fold-index keeps content from this many recent turns.
35|  audit_enabled:
36|    type: bool
37|    default: true
38|    description: Record compression savings to audit.jsonl log.
39|  usage_enabled:
40|    type: bool
41|    default: true
42|    description: Record every hook invocation (all gates + retrieves) to usage.jsonl for long-horizon use-case data.
43|  toon_enabled:
44|    type: bool
45|    default: true
46|    description: Lossless JSON to TOON columnar tables (round-trip verified; folds only when >=4 BPE tokens are saved).
47|  delta_enabled:
48|    type: bool
49|    default: true
50|    description: Cross-turn delta for repeated terminal commands (STILL FAILING / +added / -removed vs previous run).
51|  delta_threshold:
52|    type: float
53|    default: 0.65
54|    description: Similarity gate for command deltas (plan kill-criteria - raise to 0.80 if retrieves exceed ~15% of turns).
55|  min_chars:
56|    type: int
57|    default: 2048
58|    description: Minimum output size before compression kicks in.
59|  exclude_commands:
60|    type: list
61|    default: []
62|    description: Normalized command prefixes that bypass terminal-output compression.
63|  exclude_tools:
64|    type: list
65|    default: []
66|    description: Exact Hermes tool names that bypass tool-result compression.
67|  max_lines:
68|    type: int
69|    default: 120
70|    description: Default line budget for terminal output.
71|  ccr_max_entries:
72|    type: int
73|    default: 1000
74|    description: Maximum cached original files in CCR store.
75|  ccr_max_bytes:
76|    type: int
77|    default: 52428800
78|    description: Maximum byte cap for CCR storage (default 50MB).
79|  ccr_ttl_hours:
80|    type: int
81|    default: 24
82|    description: Hours before cached original files expire.
